title: GUI-Primitives UI corpus record
description: One screenshot with annotated UI elements. The benchmark synthesizer (src/guiprim/benchmark/synthesize.py) consumes a JSONL file with one such object per line.

image_path.description: Path to the screenshot, relative to the corpus file or absolute.

id.description: Unique element id within the screenshot.

type.description: Element kind: button | list_item | panel | tile | overlay | icon | text | input | ...

parent_id.description: Containing element id (e.g. the panel a list_item belongs to). Needed for containment and list_ordinal primitives.
